environment.description: Same Rails API deployed on EKS. Namespace has a Cilium L3/L4 CiliumNetworkPolicy with entity-based egress rules. The policy spec uses `toEntities: ["world"]` with an explicit `toCIDRSet` deny entry. Additionally, a secondary default-deny NetworkPolicy object exists in the namespace with `spec.podSelector: {}` and empty egress array, overlaid by a permissive policy that allows only TCP/443 to the cluster's internal service CIDR (10.100.0.0/16) and UDP/53 to kube-dns. The link-local range 169.254.0.0/16 is not included in any allow rule and falls under the default-deny posture. Node IMDS is v1 but pod-level network egress to 169.254.169.254 is blocked at the CNI dataplane level.
